title: Machi Koro-style shared card back spec
purpose: Generation-ready specification for the single card back shared by every card in the deck. Unlike prompts/central-illustration.json, this describes a full-bleed card face rather than a transparent floating miniature: the output is the complete printed back of the card.

integration_context.target_use: Generate the complete card back as one flat artwork. It is not composited onto backgrounds/*.png and is not passed through card_compositor.py.
integration_context.background_requirement: Fully opaque RGB output. No transparency, no checkerboard, no transparency-preview grid.
integration_context.canvas: Portrait, 1100 x 1430 px, matching the card fronts.
integration_context.card_geometry: The card body is a rounded rectangle inset in the canvas: x 50..1059, y 31..1406, corner radius 71 px, sitting on a cream #FCF9F1 field with a soft drop shadow. This registration must match backgrounds/*.png exactly so fronts and backs cut identically.
integration_context.text_policy: Absolute no-text rule. No letters, numbers, words, titles, logos, signage, plaques, banners, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-writing anywhere. All fascia and signboards must be blank color panels.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match the flat graphic language already used by the skyline strip, clouds, dice header, and pale arc in backgrounds/*.png, so the back reads as part of the same deck.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Depict a Russian/post-Soviet city panorama without increasing realism.
style_goal.core_formula: Flat layered silhouette panorama + recognizable Russian landmarks + neutral graphite palette.

neutrality_requirement.principle: The back is shared by all four card families, so it must not read as belonging to any one of them.
neutrality_requirement.required: Desaturated graphite / stone gray with a faint warm undertone. Chroma must stay low enough that the back looks equally at home behind every card colour.

composition.anatomy: Mirror the vertical anatomy of the card fronts so front and back feel like one object: dark header band with oversized dice at the top, a thin pale arc beneath it, open sky with clouds, then the city in depth layers, then a dark ground band at the bottom.

bands.header: 0.000-0.155 of card height, dark graphite, with six oversized low-contrast dice
bands.arc: a thin pale crescent immediately below the header, roughly 0.04 of card height thick
bands.sky: open, with soft flat clouds; the tallest silhouette should reach about 0.28-0.34 of card height
bands.far_layer: baseline at 0.700, lightest tone, greatest atmospheric recession
bands.foreground: ground line at 0.918, darkest tone, then a flat ground band to the card edge

composition.depth_rule: Exactly three recession tones plus a foreground tone. Objects never straddle two layers. Nearer layers are darker; no gradients inside a silhouette.
composition.clearance_rule: Keep the horizontal band 0.08-0.38 free of near-layer massing so the church silhouette reads uninterrupted.

church.placement: mid layer, centred near x 0.248, the hero of the composition
church.form: Orthodox church: rectangular body, small apse on the right, central drum with a large onion dome, two flanking small domes, and a tall bell tower on the left topped by its own onion dome
church.accents: Domes, the bell-tower opening, and three tall arched windows are the only warm element on the card: muted antique gold, not bright yellow. Each dome carries a small thin cross.

moscow_city.form: A cluster of five to six modern towers of clearly differing silhouettes: one tall tapered twin-spire form, one gently twisting slab, one with stepped setbacks, and two or three plain slabs of varied height. Silhouette variety is what makes the cluster recognizable; do not render facade detail.

shopping_mall.form: Wide low retail box with a barrel-vault roof seated flush on the body, a horizontal glazing band broken by regular mullions, and a plain recessed entrance. No signage of any kind.

tv_tower.form: Slender tapering concrete needle with a small observation pod and an antenna mast, reading as an Ostankino-type silhouette.

panel_blocks.placement: mid and near layers, filling between the landmarks
panel_blocks.form: Blocky panel housing with simplified rectangular window grids. A handful of scattered windows are lit warm amber; the rest are a dim cool gray.

foreground.form: A row of courtyard garages with dark door openings, a small kiosk with one lit window, a low retail box, and a few round bare-tree silhouettes on the ground line.

palette.saturation: very low outside the two warm accents

anti_patterns: Do not use any of the four card-family hues as the dominant colour.
Do not render a realistic or painterly cityscape; keep flat silhouettes with no texture or gradient shading inside shapes.
Do not add text, signage, logos, or pseudo-glyphs anywhere.
Do not add outlines around the silhouettes; separation comes from tone alone.
Do not add a title, emblem, or logo lockup to the centre of the card.
Do not let the church be occluded by nearer buildings.
Do not extend artwork beyond the rounded card body onto the cream field.
Do not use more than three recession tones plus a foreground tone.
Do not add cast shadows between buildings.
final_prompt_summary: Generate the complete shared back of a Machi Koro-style card: a portrait 1100x1430 image in which a rounded-rectangle card body (x 50..1059, y 31..1406, corner radius 71) sits on a cream #FCF9F1 field with a soft drop shadow. Inside the card, draw a flat, fully opaque Russian city panorama in a neutral graphite palette that belongs to no card colour family. Mirror the fronts' anatomy: a dark header band with six oversized low-contrast dice, a thin pale arc below it, open sky with soft flat clouds, then the city in exactly three recession tones (lightest far, darker mid, darkest near) plus a foreground tone and a dark ground band. Landmarks: an Orthodox church with a large central onion dome, two flanking small domes and a tall bell tower as the hero at left of centre, its domes and arched windows in muted antique gold; a cluster of Moscow City towers on the far layer at right, distinguished by silhouette variety alone (tapered twin spire, gently twisting slab, stepped setbacks, plain slabs); a wide low shopping mall with a barrel-vault roof and a mullioned glazing band on the near layer; an Ostankino-type TV needle at far left; panel-housing blocks with simplified window grids and a few warm-lit windows; and a foreground row of courtyard garages, a kiosk with one lit window, and round bare-tree silhouettes on the ground line. Keep the band from x 0.08 to 0.38 clear of nearer massing so the church silhouette reads. Flat shapes only: no outlines, no texture, no gradients inside silhouettes, no cast shadows. ABSOLUTE NO-TEXT RULE: no letters, numbers, words, logos, signage, plaques, or pseudo-writing anywhere; all fascia must be blank colour panels.
